mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when real GDP growth declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when industrial production increases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in retail sales signal a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate a boost in the housing sector.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and RSAFS decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when housing starts increase and retail sales decrease simultaneously within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when nonfarm payrolls decrease by more than 100,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over three consecutive months signals inflationary pressures, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the CPI increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP and decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when real GDP increases and the unemployment rate decreases simultaneously within a month.
